unusual_experiment.purpose: Discriminate ordinary deep parameter traversal from alias-ancestry copying cost.
unusual_experiment.baseline: Current production canonicalizer with per-branch set/frozenset ancestry copies.
unusual_experiment.candidate: Depth-first mutable active-alias path with explicit build-frame cleanup.
unusual_experiment.local_environment: ChatGPT Linux sandbox; not accepted Ubuntu/VPS release evidence.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The alias-wrapped shape grows much faster than the plain parameter baseline under the current copy-per-branch implementation, while the mutable-path candidate tracks approximately linear depth growth in this bounded local experiment.
unusual_experiment.counterhypothesis: The measured difference is sandbox/interpreter noise rather than structural ancestry-copy complexity.
unusual_experiment.falsifier: Run exact-head candidate and production-comparison regression on the self-hosted Linux/X64 target, then integrate only if semantic controls and scaling advantage reproduce.
